title: The Signature Vision: Amphibious Commuter Craft
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Amphibious Commuter Craft.
description:

Signature craft hulls program, charter one: master tri-mode frames at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale craft logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate mode switching systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. t: 2032 — First certified craft hulls service opens: tri-mode frames propu
title: 2032 — First certified craft hulls service opens: tri-mode frames propu
definition: 2032 milestone on the Amphibious Commuter Craft roadmap.
description:
First certified craft hulls service opens: tri-mode frames propulsion carrying paying passengers on craft logistics guideways.

What must be true first: the tri-mode frames results have to replicate outside the lab, craft logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and mode switching operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed tri-mode frames demonstrations, craft logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting mode switching uptime. When all three flash green, 2032 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (6 years from the 2026 baseline.)

definition: Estimates Amphibious Commuter Craft readiness from component maturity.

definition: Simulates Amphibious Commuter Craft operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Amphibious Commuter Craft installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 77973 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where tri-mode frames monitoring, craft logistics redundancy, or mode switching maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Amphibious Commuter Craft Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Amphibious Commuter Craft: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Amphibious Commuter Craft — craft commuting by air, land and water.

Phase 1 — Prove (tri-mode frames): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (craft logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (mode switching): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (certification): craft hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and commuters-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
